clips.title: The story
paras: At Southshore, Farren's Proof carries Marshal Redpath's orders to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle. The Marshal wants him to turn his attention to the naga pressing along the Eastern Strand.

Marshal Redpath sends word across Southshore to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle. Fresh reports speak of naga incursions on the Eastern Strand, and the Marshal wants Orinelle to focus on that threat. He orders the lieutenant to set aside other concerns, drive back the naga, and report his progress in person.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand.
When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Redpath must have just received the same information as me... Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil.
